primary_object_card.object_statement: The primary object is the complete budget-indexed ledger of which stable behavioral-object relations are fixed across every ECA dynamics pair compatible with a frozen partial-observation packet; neither a hidden rule identity nor a neural prediction may replace that consensus object.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: For each frozen observation packet, keep every hidden dynamics pair that could have produced it. A queried object relation is knowable only when all those still-possible dynamics agree, and perception-like only when they agree without collapsing to one uniquely identified dynamics pair.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The N9 exact object factory is cross-runtime green, while its depth-novel learned benchmark is blocked.
A learner must not receive installed refinement machinery, and ambiguous metric scope must fail closed.

native_terms.version space: Every ordered distinct rule pair consistent with all visible action-labelled transitions.
native_terms.query identifiable: Every compatible dynamics pair assigns the same stable object relation to the query.
native_terms.consensus without identification: At least eight effective unordered dynamics hypotheses and at least two full partition relations remain, but all imply the same queried object relation.

weirdness_signature: object identity can be fixed while underlying dynamics remain underdetermined
more observation can convert impossibility into consensus and then into mere system identification
the useful regime is an interval rather than maximal information
primary_object_card.domain: 531 test-rule symmetry-family representatives, five cumulative observation budgets, and all 9636 same-probe N9 state queries
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: exact compatible-rule sets, query identifiability vectors, regime summaries, and benchmark-admission decision
allowed_operations: intersect object-relation truth across version spaces
classify information-missing, system-ID, trivial-target, and consensus regimes
required_invariants: the true ordered rule pair remains in every version space
all frozen budgets and test fixtures remain visible
queries share P0 and are label-independent
exact engines cannot read peer results
consensus is computed across all compatible dynamics, not sampled hypotheses
forbidden_substitutions: unique hidden rule identity for object-relation consensus
one favorable budget for the complete budget ledger
stable label or proxy replacement for the version-space consensus object
P0 equality for stable behavioral equivalence
negative_controls: erase all but P0 and require nontriviality gates to fail
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: ECA rule names, observation trajectories, version-space members, Julia/JAX implementations, and later neural scores are adapters or probes around the consensus object; none may replace it.
promotion_locks: no learner before exact identifiability census closes
no perception-like wording when version spaces are singleton-dominated
no success wording when relation targets are one-class
no QIT, MMM, ontology, or cross-domain promotion from the ECA scout
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: preregistered Codex-Ratchet packet with independent exact engines, controller, and fabrication audit

lateral_mappings.label: version-space consensus
lateral_mappings.kill_control: compatible hypotheses assigning both relation values make the query unidentifiable

lateral_mappings.kill_control: a changed packet defines a different inference object

lateral_mappings.label: consensus as perception
preserves: object relation without unique dynamics identity
lateral_mappings.kill_control: fewer than eight effective hypotheses or one remaining full partition relation demotes the task to system identification or trivial consensus

fixation_breakers: allow the scout to show no usable information window
separate object consensus from hidden-rule recovery

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first version-space or query-consensus mismatch before interpreting regimes
loop_contract.stop_condition: all exact ledgers agree or the scout remains red

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless explicitly requested.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any sequence or ordering claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve frozen packet and query baselines while repairing execution.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed/open/survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge of identifiability, learnability, and general perception.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve recoverable finite facts with tools before asking the human.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard; v4.2 is legacy/provenance only.

sim_audit_receipts.status: exact census green; learned V2 blocked

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: object-preservation and preregistration only until exact identifiability engines run
